note: The client's claim about itself. Each code appears in exactly one half, split by whether the client can construct it without reading one from the edge's body: `mintedByClient` holds those it constructs (a bare 400 becomes invalid_request, a bare 401 or a missing token becomes unauthorized, an unparseable body becomes invalid_response, a dead stream becomes connection_lost, and a throw around the stream becomes internal_error), and `recognisedFromServer` holds those it only ever reads from a body. Every entry can be checked against CloudRouteClient. specRevision is the revision of the spec table this claim was last checked against; bumping it is a deliberate act, not a side effect of an edit.
